decision_conditions: Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 7am to 6pm Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm on Saturday and 7am to 5pm on Sunday and Bank Holidays'.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the change of use hereby permitted is initiated.

Condition : 8 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. The new extract system should as a minimum, and in accordance with good practice, comprise a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter and have the ducting isolated from the building structure, the fan unit should be mounted on anti-vibration mountings, fan silencers should be incorporated and acute bends to the ducting should be minimised.
Condition : 9 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7am-5.30pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
description: Change of use from retail unit to cafe.
